name: A 1157-Concept Obstruction with One Edge Wing and One Singleton Wing
definition: Let $C\subseteq Q_{12}$ be the certified rooted factor of order $289$, let $\widehat C=\{2^{12}x:x\in C\}$, and put $O=C\cup\widehat C$, $B_0=O\cup\{128,160\}$, and $B_1=O\cup\{2^{12}290\}$. Add a fresh layer coordinate and form $X=(B_0\times\{0\})\cup(B_1\times\{1\})$.
parameters: $X$ has $1157$ concepts on $25$ active coordinates; its negative overlap $O$ has $577$ concepts.
properties: The two sections and their contraction are dismantlable ample, while the two exclusive wings are respectively an edge and a singleton with no edge between them. The edge wing peels to the overlap in the order $(160,128)$. The overlap is the cut-vertex gluing of two copies of the root-negative factor $C$, so it is forbidden; the one-relative-wing inverse theorem makes $X$ an ample pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness.
